title: Rules of construction.
bodyText: The rules of construction that apply in this State to the interpretation of and disposition of property by will also apply, as appropriate, to the interpretation of the terms of a trust and the disposition of the trust property.
bodyHtml: [§554D-112]  Rules of construction.  The rules of construction that apply in this State to the interpretation of and disposition of property by will also apply, as appropriate, to the interpretation of the terms of a trust and the disposition of the trust property. [L 2021, c 32, pt of §2]
